verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents query the Stripe API directly. It also offers the Invoicing API, invoice statuses such as unpaid, overdue and uncollectible, and a preview-invoice endpoint, so an agent can look up a customer's invoices and spot delinquent or upcoming ones. Missing for 10: no evidence of MRR or metric computation, no detail on which MCP tools cover billing queries like renewals or delinquency, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent querying.
